name: The Wounds of Betrayal
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious.

Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
narrative.objectives: Enter the Nightfang Den and heal 7 druids and find Jorel Windsinger in Shadowgale Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Elegael's face pales as you relay the fate of Jorel and the condition of the rest of the druids.>No... no! This is far worse than I had--<Elegael chokes back a sob, and grits her teeth letting out a pained snarl.>They will pay. They will ALL pay. Anyone who allies with the Al'aketh will feel my wrath! This I swear.
narrative.requestItemsText: champion! You have returned. Were you able to reach my brothers and sisters? Did you find Jorel?
